sentences.text:
(Presently Lodged At Dist. Jail,
Banswara)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp

----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Hitendra Singh For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Gehlot, PP with  Mr. Omprakash Choudhary  Mr. Himmat Kumar, SHO Police  Station Patan, District Banswara.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 06/02/2025

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.73/2024 of Police Station Patan, District Banswara, for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 344,
376(2)(N), 376(3) of IPC and Section 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act and Section 84 of Juvenile Justice Act.
He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that according to the statement of Smt. Asha, who stated that accused Rahul and Nar Singh took deceased Guddi and the Police has not made an accused to Nar Singh.
It is further submitted that as per the medical report the cause of death is Generalised Tonic Clonic Seizure and no poisonous substance was detected in the body of deceased.

Counsel submits that other co-accused have been [2025:RJ-JD:7545] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-11226/2024]
enlarged on bail and upto this time no prosecution witnesses have been examined before the trial Court.
The accused-petitioner has been in judicial custody since 31.05.2024 and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.

1
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Rahul S/o Dhan Singh, shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.73/2024 of Police Station Patan, District Banswara, provided he executes personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
